predictions.rationale: Defines the graph model that represents the elements and relationships shown in Collaboration (Communication) diagrams; core to creating and managing these diagrams.
Handles drawing/rendering of collaboration-diagram elements on screen, directly implementing the visual aspect of the feature.
Implements user-interaction/selection logic for ClassifierRole figures that appear in collaboration diagrams, supporting editing of these diagrams.
UI action for adding a new Action to a Message within a collaboration diagram, directly supporting diagram manipulation for interactions.
Model helper dedicated to UML Collaborations; supplies operations used by diagram tools to create and query collaboration elements.
MDR-based implementation of CollaborationsHelper, enabling persistence and manipulation of collaboration models for the diagram feature.
Factory responsible for constructing Collaboration-related UML elements in the MDR model implementation, necessary for diagram creation.
EUML (EMF) counterpart of CollaborationsHelper; supports the same collaboration concepts for projects using the EUML backend.
Explorer navigation rule that links Collaboration model elements to their corresponding diagrams, enhancing access to the feature.
Test case for the action creating Collaboration diagrams, indicating and validating the presence and behavior of the feature.
